top_choice_rationale: P002 (Kane, Mele, Molenkamp, citation tied to the quantum spin Hall state and Z2 topological insulators) rewards a new organising principle, band topology, that was predicted theoretically and then confirmed by the quantised edge conductance in HgTe wells, with about two decades of independent confirmation by transport and ARPES and agreement with first-principles electronic-structure theory. Kane and Mele's joint Z2 work is not split, and a 2D-scoped citation avoids the unresolved 3D attribution (Fu, Hasan). The remaining weakness is the unverified Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang credit, but I judge it narrower than the case against P001. P001 (Katori and Ye, optical lattice clock) is mature, independently reproduced at the 1e-18 level and cleanly credited, so I rank it second and well above no award, though I weigh a new principle for matter above a very large gain in measurement precision.
recusal_note: No tie to any credited laureate, but I work on electronic-structure theory of magnetic and topological materials, a field-proximity bias toward P002 that colleagues should discount; I judge it does not require recusal.
